caption:

issues: Fact corrected to match the article: Answers are on slide 6 of 7; the last slide (7) is just a comment prompt.
Slide 1: The cover is a da Vinci anatomical sketch that shows nude male genitals. Instagram may flag it as sensitive. Consider a cropped or different cover image.

Slide 2: The skin photo is a small, low-resolution rectangle on a heavily blurred copy of itself. It looks unpolished. I did not drop it because Q1 would then be missing and the answers slide refers to it. A larger or sharper skin photo would be better.
Slide 7: The closing slide asks "Aap kya sochte ho?", which doesn't fit a quiz. Something like "Kitne sahi hue?" would fit better. This is optional.
fixed: answers last slide par hain → answers 6th slide par hain
